extra.final_summary: The data had two main issues: (1) two rows with invalid flipper_length_mm values (-185 and -212 mm) that were below the minimum allowed value of 170 mm; these were excluded. (2) Two rows with body_mass_g values (4,450,000 and 5,700,000 grams) that exceeded the maximum allowed value of 6,500 grams; these were also excluded. Additionally, the 'sex' column had a case variant 'FEMALE' that was normalized to 'female'. After these fixes, the average body mass for each species was calculated: Adelie: 3,687.5 g, Chinstrap: 3,726.7 g, Gentoo: 5,253.6 g.
